product.name: Ontop Contractor of Record
product.description: A contractor hiring and management service for onboarding, contracting, compliance, payroll, and payments across more than 150 countries.

product.name: Global Payroll and Payments
product.description: A global payroll service for calculating and processing contractor payments in multiple currencies across more than 150 countries, with compliance and tax administration.

product.name: Ontop Global Account
product.description: A financial account for remote workers and freelancers to invoice clients, receive funds in USDc, move money internationally, and spend through a Visa Platinum card.

product.name: Ontop Reserve
product.description: A paid financial membership for global workers that provides cashback, transfer savings, travel and productivity benefits, wellness and pet-care benefits, and travel protection.
